admissions.dashboard @ admin.decision: Admin Hub redesign, Phase 2 (bookings.admissions): GET /api/admissions/dashboard/, read-only, opens for accounts.view_all_leads -- the ADMIN role's alone, held by superusers too (D1). Over a span of Indian dates (the last seven by default) it counts the leads that came in and their pipeline stage, and the Demo and Diagnostic bookings for those dates; then today's bookings, what awaits an administrator, the latest leads and the latest admissions activity. auth.me @ admin.decision: A2 (unified-permission sprint): /me reports every effective permission. Lead management (accounts.0018): the ADMIN role group carries accounts.view_all_leads and accounts.add_lead, which only the ADMIN role may hold; superusers hold every permission (D1). Nothing else in /me changes. Student Local Time (accounts.0019): the ADMIN and BDE role groups carry accounts.change_student_timezone, which only those two roles may hold; superusers hold every permission (D1). Nothing else in /me changes.
auth.me @ admin.note: The Hub builds its navigation, route guards and actions from /me, so /me lists the full effective set (role group + grants, within the role ceiling; superusers: the whole catalogue) instead of view_team only. The ADMIN role group gained accounts.manage_booking_slots with DEVT-5973 (booking slots). It gained accounts.view_all_bookings and accounts.assign_booking_tutor with booking management (Phase 2). The catalogue gained the eleven Demo/Diagnostic workflow permissions with Phase 5.2 P2 (accounts.0015, seeded ahead of the phases that enforce them; they open no endpoint yet): the ADMIN group carries reschedule_booking (only the Admin reschedules, Q23), cancel_booking (the Admin and the owner BDE cancel, Q22), share_booking_report, view_conversion_tracker, manage_conversions and assign_lead_owner; the TUTOR group submit_booking_report. The catalogue gained the five parent communication permissions with BDE-to-PDF Phase 2A (accounts.0017, seeded ahead of the APIs that enforce them; they open no endpoint yet): the ADMIN group carries send_lead_communications, record_parent_confirmation, view_all_communications and manage_message_templates; the BDE group view_own_lead_communications, send_lead_communications and record_parent_confirmation. Gains accounts.add_lead and accounts.view_all_leads; nothing else changes. Gains accounts.change_student_timezone; nothing else changes.

bookings.assign_tutor @ admin.decision: Booking management (Phase 2): /api/bookings/ serves holders of accounts.view_all_bookings (reading every booking and which tutors are free for its slot) and accounts.assign_booking_tutor (changing a booking's tutor), which only the ADMIN role may hold (a superuser holds both under D1). P6 (design E.1): a booking's rows and detail say whether it has its report and at which version, and whether one is due (has_report, report_version, report_due); the detail also names the report (report: id, version, when and by whom it was submitted, or null). BDE-to-PDF workflow Phase 1 (tutor permanent Google Meet link, scope approved 2026-11-03): one permanent Google Meet link per tutor (profiles.tutor_meet_link), created and changed only by team managers -- the Admin role, and superusers under D1 -- through PUT /api/team/<id>/meet-link/ (accounts.manage_team); each booking keeps its own copy (tutor_meet_link), shown to the Admin, the owner BDE and the tutor. Explicit Start Demo / Start Diagnostic (decisions D1-D6, approved 2026-11-05): every Admin booking answer adds read-only start information -- activity_state (bookings.lifecycle), started_at, and in full started_by -- with no change to who reaches it. Demo invitations (bookings.demo_invites): the Admin's booking detail gains actions.demo_invite (a Diagnostic whose report is in, the child CBSE, no Demo to come or done, the caller holding accounts.send_lead_communications) and channel / created_by / invited_from (a Demo booked with an invitation is a BDE handoff, made by whoever sent it, from the Diagnostic it names). Re-Demos (bookings.redemos): the Admin's booking answers gain actions.request_redemo (a COMPLETED Demo, the caller holding accounts.reschedule_booking), redemo_request (the Re-Demo request a RE-DEMO REQUIRED Demo was sent for) and redemo_from (the request an administrator scheduled a Demo for), and the list's rows redemo_for_id (that request's id, or null). Student Local Time (bookings.student_timezones): every lead and booking carries student_timezone -- the IANA zone the student books from, or null when it is not known -- for the student's own time beside the Indian one; a booking's lead brief carries it too.

Demo invitations (bookings.demo_invites): the Admin's booking detail gains actions.demo_invite (a Diagnostic whose report is in, the child CBSE, no Demo to come or done, the caller holding accounts.send_lead_communications) and channel / created_by / invited_from (a Demo booked with an invitation is a BDE handoff, made by whoever sent it, from the Diagnostic it names). Re-Demos (bookings.redemos): the Admin's booking answers gain actions.request_redemo (a COMPLETED Demo, the caller holding accounts.reschedule_booking), redemo_request (the Re-Demo request a RE-DEMO REQUIRED Demo was sent for) and redemo_from (the request an administrator scheduled a Demo for), and the list's rows redemo_for_id (that request's id, or null). Student Local Time (bookings.student_timezones): every lead and booking carries student_timezone -- the IANA zone the student books from, or null when it is not known -- for the student's own time beside the Indian one; a booking's lead brief carries it too.

bookings.list @ admin.decision: Booking management (Phase 2): /api/bookings/ serves holders of accounts.view_all_bookings (reading every booking and which tutors are free for its slot) and accounts.assign_booking_tutor (changing a booking's tutor), which only the ADMIN role may hold (a superuser holds both under D1). P6 (design E.1): a booking's rows and detail say whether it has its report and at which version, and whether one is due (has_report, report_version, report_due); the detail also names the report (report: id, version, when and by whom it was submitted, or null). Explicit Start Demo / Start Diagnostic (decisions D1-D6, approved 2026-11-05): every Admin booking answer adds read-only start information -- activity_state (bookings.lifecycle), started_at, and in full started_by -- with no change to who reaches it. Re-Demos (bookings.redemos): the Admin's booking answers gain actions.request_redemo (a COMPLETED Demo, the caller holding accounts.reschedule_booking), redemo_request (the Re-Demo request a RE-DEMO REQUIRED Demo was sent for) and redemo_from (the request an administrator scheduled a Demo for), and the list's rows redemo_for_id (that request's id, or null). Student Local Time (bookings.student_timezones): every lead and booking carries student_timezone -- the IANA zone the student books from, or null when it is not known -- for the student's own time beside the Indian one; a booking's lead brief carries it too.

bookings.redemo @ admin.decision: Re-Demo management (bookings.redemos, approved scope 2026-11-07, corrected the same day to Admin scheduling): a COMPLETED Demo may be sent for a Re-Demo with a required reason -- by the Admin for any lead (POST /api/bookings/demo/<id>/redemo/, accounts.view_all_bookings + accounts.reschedule_booking) or by the BDE who owns the lead (POST /api/bde/bookings/demo/<id>/redemo/, accounts.view_own_enquiries + accounts.create_demo_booking, ownership checked in the view and again under the lead lock) -- and becomes RE-DEMO REQUIRED at once. The Admin reads every request (GET /api/bookings/redemos/, /<id>/, /<id>/tutors/: accounts.view_all_bookings) and alone schedules it -- the tutor's free slots (GET /<id>/slots/?tutor_id=) and the booking itself with its tutor, slot and remarks (POST /<id>/schedule/) -- and keeps its remarks (PUT /<id>/remarks/), each + accounts.assign_booking_tutor. No parent invitation and no public endpoint: the BDE tells the parent the confirmed time.

bookings.reschedule @ admin.decision: Booking operations (Phase 5.2 P3, Admin side; Q9, Q22, Q23, Q24, Q26 answered 2026-10-31): the history timeline needs accounts.view_all_bookings; reschedule options and rescheduling need view_all_bookings and accounts.reschedule_booking (the Admin only, Q23); cancelling needs view_all_bookings and accounts.cancel_booking, so a BDE, who holds cancel_booking for their own leads (Q22), never reaches these Admin routes. Reasons are codes from a fixed list (Q9), never free text (M1). P6 (design E.1): a booking's rows and detail say whether it has its report and at which version, and whether one is due (has_report, report_version, report_due); the detail also names the report (report: id, version, when and by whom it was submitted, or null). BDE-to-PDF workflow Phase 1 (tutor permanent Google Meet link, scope approved 2026-11-03): one permanent Google Meet link per tutor (profiles.tutor_meet_link), created and changed only by team managers -- the Admin role, and superusers under D1 -- through PUT /api/team/<id>/meet-link/ (accounts.manage_team); each booking keeps its own copy (tutor_meet_link), shown to the Admin, the owner BDE and the tutor. Explicit Start Demo / Start Diagnostic (decisions D1-D6, approved 2026-11-05): every Admin booking answer adds read-only start information -- activity_state (bookings.lifecycle), started_at, and in full started_by -- with no change to who reaches it. Demo invitations (bookings.demo_invites): the Admin's booking detail gains actions.demo_invite (a Diagnostic whose report is in, the child CBSE, no Demo to come or done, the caller holding accounts.send_lead_communications) and channel / created_by / invited_from (a Demo booked with an invitation is a BDE handoff, made by whoever sent it, from the Diagnostic it names). Re-Demos (bookings.redemos): the Admin's booking answers gain actions.request_redemo (a COMPLETED Demo, the caller holding accounts.reschedule_booking), redemo_request (the Re-Demo request a RE-DEMO REQUIRED Demo was sent for) and redemo_from (the request an administrator scheduled a Demo for), and the list's rows redemo_for_id (that request's id, or null). Student Local Time (bookings.student_timezones): every lead and booking carries student_timezone -- the IANA zone the student books from, or null when it is not known -- for the student's own time beside the Indian one; a booking's lead brief carries it too.

bookings.slot_change @ admin.decision: DEVT-5973 (booking slots): /api/booking-slots/ serves holders of accounts.manage_booking_slots, which only the ADMIN role may hold (a superuser holds it under D1). P6 (design E.1): a booking's rows and detail say whether it has its report and at which version, and whether one is due (has_report, report_version, report_due); the detail also names the report (report: id, version, when and by whom it was submitted, or null). BDE-to-PDF workflow Phase 1 (tutor permanent Google Meet link, scope approved 2026-11-03): one permanent Google Meet link per tutor (profiles.tutor_meet_link), created and changed only by team managers -- the Admin role, and superusers under D1 -- through PUT /api/team/<id>/meet-link/ (accounts.manage_team); each booking keeps its own copy (tutor_meet_link), shown to the Admin, the owner BDE and the tutor. Explicit Start Demo / Start Diagnostic (decisions D1-D6, approved 2026-11-05): every Admin booking answer adds read-only start information -- activity_state (bookings.lifecycle), started_at, and in full started_by -- with no change to who reaches it. Demo invitations (bookings.demo_invites): the Admin's booking detail gains actions.demo_invite (a Diagnostic whose report is in, the child CBSE, no Demo to come or done, the caller holding accounts.send_lead_communications) and channel / created_by / invited_from (a Demo booked with an invitation is a BDE handoff, made by whoever sent it, from the Diagnostic it names). Re-Demos (bookings.redemos): the Admin's booking answers gain actions.request_redemo (a COMPLETED Demo, the caller holding accounts.reschedule_booking), redemo_request (the Re-Demo request a RE-DEMO REQUIRED Demo was sent for) and redemo_from (the request an administrator scheduled a Demo for), and the list's rows redemo_for_id (that request's id, or null). Student Local Time (bookings.student_timezones): every lead and booking carries student_timezone -- the IANA zone the student books from, or null when it is not known -- for the student's own time beside the Indian one; a booking's lead brief carries it too.
